title: Palace: Clearing ops ahead of Asean for ‘safety’ of delegates

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Malacañang on Tuesday said the clearing operations conducted in some parts of Pasay and Parañaque cities and nearby areas are for the “safety” of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) delegates. In a briefing, Palace press officer Claire Castro responded to criticisms that the government is “concealing” the country’s poverty for the high-level event happening from Nov. 15 to 17. The Asean Leaders’ Summit will be held at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City, with ministerial meetings set at a luxury hotel in the same area.
